experiment_data.hypothesis: D030: GRPO v7 — v6 OOM fix. 8-bit AdamW optimizer (bitsandbytes) saves ~50% optimizer memory. max_steps=100 (~756s/step). All other params same as v6: max_completion_length=1024, beta=0.01, temp=0.4, rep_penalty=1.15, format_reward=0.1, gradient_checkpointing=True, monkey-patch ref_model.
experiment_data.notes: v7 changes from v6: (1) 8-bit AdamW optimizer via bitsandbytes (adamw_bnb_8bit) — saves ~50% optimizer memory, peak GPU ~96.5GB vs v6 OOM at 95GB; (2) added --max_steps 100 support to train_grpo_v5.py. Dry-run confirmed 1 step completes in ~756s without OOM on single RTX PRO 6000 (98GB).
